notes.title: Update v0.0.10.2 - New Magic System, Difficulty System, Flying Enemies and more!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096858/72c54ab6a5e11f45cd4bc78b455a76691b920449.jpg
Hey there everyone!
New update is out!
It's been almost half a year since the last update. I've been super busy adding a bunch of new stuff so this update will have many new things.
I finally added the magic system that takes the combat system to a whole new level. Really looking forward to seeing everyone's feedback on the system.
I also added a bunch of other stuff like a flying enemy, difficulty system, warrior selection system and improved a bunch of stuff like the combat speed and better animations.
Hope everyone enjoys the new improvements and I look forward to reading all everyone's feedback!

New Features

 Magic System
 Added MP system
 Difficulty System
 Warrior Selection System
 Added propper level up progression system
 Improved combat speed
 Added better combat animations
 Added cayote time system 
 Added zoomed in zone system
 Improved Knockback system
 Added shadows for enemies
 Added more combat SFX
 Added ambiance SFX
 Added new defeated end screen
 Improved Faris' texture to not be too dark

And a bunch of other new additions and improvements

Bug Fixes

 Fixed air combat attacking enemies that are too far away
 Fixed Treasure Chest collision issue
 Fixed lock-on being unresponsive sometimes
 Fixed Breakable objects spawning drops infinitely 
 Fixed FPS setting not working

And a bunch of other fixes

notes.title: New Update v0.0.8.0 - Quality of life Improvement and new Bouncing Ball!!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096858/e039882afc59eeab5ae7168290c2567815a63133.png
Hey there everyone!
New update is out!
Wanted to give everyone an update before the end of the year!
The latest update has a lot of quality-of-life improvements to the movement, combat, enemies and UI.
I also added a bouncing ball in the Playground and Slums area that you can play with and practice Air Combos with!
Hope everyone enjoys the new improvements and I look forward to reading all everyone's feedback!

New Features

 Bouncing Ball
 Added auto save system
 Added a debug menu for better testing
 Improved the Movement system
 Added smooth rotation when turning
 Added a new advanced enemy spawn system
 Enemies AI has been improved where they feel more active now
 Combat has been improved with less missed attacks
 Added exp pop up when deafening enemies
 Added a new parry animation for Faris
 Added a "are you sure you want to quit" when pressing the Title Screen button
 Added UI sound effects
 Updated pause menu with more player stats
 Added spinning spikes in playground for parry testing
 Updated the Credits menu with new features and with the latest playtesters
 Added shadows for all enemy
 Added camera zoom system when entering enclosed spaces


Bug Fixes

 Scrolling with controller doesn't work properly sometimes
 Arabic localization not working
 Attacking down the stairs will always do an upward hit
 Level design collision problems
 Bad collisions on lanterns
 Camera settings not working

notes.title: New Update v0.0.7.1 (New Equipment and Inventory System)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096858/dcf3bafcc26c373b5847113cab21f494fecd597a.png
Hey there everyone!
New update is out!
Finally added an equipment and inventory system that allows for item gathering and equipping!
Now you can collect items all around the city and from enemies too.
This is still just the start of this system, over time I will keep adding more and more items.
I've also done several combat tweaks and other system improvements!

New Features

 Added new Inventory System
 Added new Equipment System (can equip different items and weapons)
 Added new Quick Menu system (to use items during battle)
 Added item drops (from defeated enemies)
 Treasure Chest now gives items
 A total overhaul of the attack trace system
 A total overhaul of the movement system
 Added a Defeated Menu
 Added enemy jumping ability
 Improved Enemy AI behavior
 Improve overall UI gamepad navigation
 Updated the Dialogue system


Bug Fixes

 Can't break crates
 Gamepad UI issues
 Dodge roll sometimes not working
 Rising Slash bugs out enemies

notes.title: New Update v0.0.6.7
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45096858/6432b7f4c1bb88176124e25905732fd885369275.png
Hey there everyone!
The new update is out!
Finally releasing the update that adds the new lighting, language options, the final Faris model, and a bunch of other improvements!
Updates have been a bit slow due to being busy with my latest Devlog which should be out next week! After that, I'll be back to working on the game! 
Looking forward to hearing everyone's feedback! 😁👍

New Features

 Added Lighting to all Environments
 Added Japanese Localization
 Added Language option in settings
 Final Faris' model added
 Added new Faris HUD UI
 Added more Faris SFXs
 Added Blocking VFX
 Added enemy jumping mechanic
 Improved enemy roaming AI
 Improved enemy spawn and despawn system
 Improved Orb Drops with better collision and effects
 Breakable objects shake when hit
 Refined drops stats


Bug Fixes

 Fixed Camera reset issue in PC controls
 Fixed bug where you can spam NPC talk button
 Fixed getting soft-locked when ground slammed
 Fixed enemy AI breaking when using Rising Slash
